s: lakAraH । sa tu yavargasya tftIyo varRo vyaYjanasyAzwAviMSavarRaSca । asyoccAraRasTAnaM dantaH । iti vyAkaraRam ॥ (taTAca sidDAntakOmudyAm । “xtulasAnAM dantAH ॥”) tasya svarUpaM yaTA, -- “lakAraM caYcalApANgi ! kuRqalItrayasaMyutam । pItavidyullatAkAraM sarvvaratnapradAyakam ॥ paYcadevamayaM varRaM paYcaprARamayaM sadA । triSaktisahitaM varRaM tribindusahitaM sadA । AtmAditattvasahitaM hfdi BAvaya pArvvati ! ॥” iti kAmaDenutantram ॥ * ॥ (vaNgIyavarRamAlAyAm .) asya leKanaprakAro yaTA, -- “kuRqalItrayasaMyuktA vAmAddakzagatA tvaDaH । punarUrdDvagatA reKA tAsu nArAyaRaH SivaH । brahmaSaktiSca santizWedDyAnamasya pracakzate ॥” DyAnaM yaTA, -- “caturBujAM pItavastrAM raktapaNkajalocanAm । sarvvadA varadAM BImAM sarvvAlaNkAraBUzitAm ॥ yogIndrasevitAM nityAM yoginIM yogarUpiRIm । caturvargapradAM devIM nAgahAropaSoBitAm ॥ evaM DyAtvA lakArantu tanmantraM daSaDA japet ॥” iti varRodDAratantram ॥ tasya nAmAni yaTA, -- “laScandraH pUtanA pfTvI mADavaH SakravAcakaH । balAnujaH pinAkISo vyApako mAMsasaMjYakaH ॥ KaqgI nAdo'mftaM devI lavaRaM vAruRIpatiH । SiKA vARI kriyA mAtA BAminI kAminI priyA ॥ jvAlinI veginI nAdaH pradyumnaH SozaRo hariH । viSvAtmamantrO balI ceto merurgiriH kalA rasaH ॥” iti nAnAtantraSAstram ॥ (anubanDaviSezaH । yaTA, kavikalpadrume । “divAdyo ylAdAdikaH .” etena ad lO BakzaRe lugdByo'paH । atti iti ॥ CandaHSAstrokto laGusaMjYako gaRaviSezaH । iti CandomaYjarI ॥)
klI, (lIyate'treti । lI + aBiDAnAnnirupapade'pi qaH .) pfTvIbIjam । iti tantram ॥
puM, (lAtIti । lA + ac .) indraH । iti BedinI । le, 1 ॥
v: pu॰ lA--ka । 1 indre medi॰ tantrokte BUmidEvatAke 2 mantraBede na॰ 2 ekalaGuke varRe । laqAdidaSasu lakArAdi tiqpratyayezu “laH karmaRi ca BAve cAkarmakeByaH pA॰ ।
m: 1. ल the 3rd semivowel (corresponding to the vowels ऌ, ॡ, and having the sound of the English l)

a technical term for all the tenses and moods of a finite verb or for the terminations of those tenses and moods (also applied to some forms with कृत् affixes construed like a finite verb, Pāṇ. ii, 3, 69; cf. iii, 2, 124, and when accompanied by certain indicatory letters denoting each tense separately See लट्; लङ्; लिङ्; लोट्; लिट्; लुट्; ऌट्; लुङ्; ऌङ्; लेट्), Pāṇ. iii, 4, 69; 77, Sch.
2. ल m. N. of Indra, L.
3. ल (in prosody) = लघु, a short syllable.
a: लः — 1 An epithet of Indra. --2 A short syllable (in prosody). --3 A technical term used by Pāṇini for the ten tenses and moods (there being ten lakāras).
